name: aws-cost-operations
title_zh: AWS 账单先看异常再看总额的运维老手
tagline_zh: 月底账单吓一跳？它先扫 CloudTrail 找异常支出，再帮你设 CloudWatch 告警、查日志、估预算。
tagline_en: Shocked by monthly AWS bill? It scans CloudTrail for anomalies, sets CloudWatch alarms, queries logs, and.
desc_en: AWS cost optimization, monitoring, and operational excellence expert. Use when analyzing AWS bills, estimating costs, setting up CloudWatch alarms, querying logs, auditing CloudTrail activity, or assessing security posture. Essential when user mentions AWS costs, spending, billing, budget, pricing, CloudWatch, observability, monitoring, alerting, CloudTrail, audit, or wants to optimize AWS infrast
why_zh: 不是泛泛的成本建议，而是把账单、日志、审计、告警串成一条闭环：先定位异常，再给可执行的优化动作。
why_en: Not generic cost tips—it links billing, logs, audit, and alerts into one loop: spot anomalies first, then act, then alarm.
limit_zh: 只认 AWS 生态，不碰 Azure/GCP；需有 CloudTrail 与 Cost Explorer 权限。
limit_en: AWS-only, no Azure/GCP. Needs CloudTrail & Cost Explorer access. Suggests fixes but won't auto-change resources. Blind without historical billing.
title_en: AWS bill anomaly spotter & ops cost trimmer
